name: Extra Technique
body:
You have learned a new technique to further express your skill at your discipline.

Prerequisite(s): Technique class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional wandering artist technique. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this technique.

Special: You can gain Extra Technique multiple times. Each time you must select a different technique.

The Wandering Artist 2014, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Andrew Howe, Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
